Stuffed Cinnamon Rolls

  • 2 Pkgs Ready-made Cinnamon Rolls with icing
  • 8-oz Cream Cheese
  • 1/4 Cup Sugar
  • 1/2 tsp Vanilla
  • 1/2 Cup Milk

Mix thoroughly cream cheese, sugar, vanilla, then add milk and mix again; freeze for 1 hour.

Flatten out each of the pre-made cinnamon rolls in both packages to about double their size: one will be the bottom fashioned like a cup to hold about 2 Tbs of the frozen cream cheese mix and the other flattened cinnamon roll will be the top; mold into a slight ball shape and place in round cake pan (probably greased to prevent sticking).

Bake for 20-25 minutes at 400F/200C. Remove from oven and add one or both icing packages to the top. Makes six; calories-who cares!
